step.prompt: /crew-brainstorm Teamly: a small SaaS where a team keeps shared to-do lists (sign in, create a workspace, invite teammates, lists, tasks, assign, complete). Constraints: two developers, four weeks to a demo, Python FastAPI + React, Postgres, deploy on one cloud. Judged on: demoable in 3 minutes, technical quality, usefulness to a 5-person team. Do not ask me questions; make reasonable assumptions and mark them [assumed]. Write docs/01-brainstorm-and-decision.md and finish.
step.judge: Read docs/01-brainstorm-and-decision.md. Score 5 if it has inputs with weighted criteria, a problem scan, 5+ options, a scoring table with arithmetic, a one-paragraph decision a stranger could repeat, out-of-scope and a cut line, risks with mitigations, and name candidates. Score 3 if the decision and scoring exist but sections are thin. Score 1 if it is a generic essay without scoring or decision.

judge.reason: docs/01-brainstorm-and-decision.md has weighted criteria (4/3/3) in section 1.2, an 8-row problem scan, 8 options (A–H), a scoring table with shown arithmetic (e.g. B: 20+12+15=47) plus rationale for non-obvious scores, a one-paragraph decision a stranger could repeat, explicit out-of-scope list with a week-by-week cut line, six risks each with mitigation and owner, and three name candidates with verdicts.
